### Changed
- An in-cluster `jwtAuthentication.jwks.host` in a namespace, or on a port, that `gateway.jwksEgress` does not name now fails the render, under `networkPolicy.enabled`. That key renders one rule, for one namespace on one port, so a host elsewhere reached nothing while the render stayed green and every request read `401 token uses the unknown key`. The message names the value to set. Both guards stand down for a host reached by address: `gateway.jwksEgress.external.cidrs` non-empty on an `external.port` equal to the route's `jwks.port`, which is how a second in-cluster issuer is carried — the one rule covers one namespace on one port, so two routes on in-cluster hosts in different namespaces cannot both be satisfied. `gateway.jwksEgress.podSelector` is read by no guard, because a hostname carries no pod labels. An installation whose issuer is `dex.giantswarm.svc.cluster.local` on 5556, the default, is unaffected.
